typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	GetClypsoLoadDate as string ('2020-12-02 00:00:00'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		SWORIGINALCOUNTERPARTY as string,
		OP_RESPONSE as string,
		REPORTING_PARTY as string,
		INTERNAL as string,
		CLEARING_CPTY as string,
		BILATERAL as string,
		TRADE_COUNTERPARTYTYPE as string,
		TRADE_CLEARED_DATE as timestamp,
		EXEC_TIME as string,
		EXECUTIONDATETIME as string,
		CCPCLEAREDDATE as string,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetClypsoKeywords
GetClypsoKeywords derive(oBILATERAL = BILATERAL,
		oTRADE_COUNTERPARTYTYPE = TRADE_COUNTERPARTYTYPE,
		oEXEC_TIME = toTimestamp(toString(EXEC_TIME, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),
		oSWORIGINALCPTY = SWORIGINALCOUNTERPARTY,
		oPROD_DESC = DESCRIPTION,
		oINTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		oTRADE_ID = toString(TRADE_ID),
		oTRADE_CLEARED_DATE = TRADE_CLEARED_DATE,
		oPRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		oREPORTING_PARTY = REPORTING_PARTY,
		oCLEARING_CPTY = CLEARING_CPTY,
		oCCPCLEAREDDATE = CCPCLEAREDDATE,
		oEXECUTIONDATETIME = EXECUTIONDATETIME,
		oOP_RESPONSE = OP_RESPONSE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(Modified_Date = toDate(toString($GetClypsoLoadDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Orig_CPTY as string,
		Product_Description as string,
		executionTime_Cly as string,
		PM_Response as string,
		CLEARING_CPTY as string,
		Execution_Time as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Trade_Id as string,
		product_Family as string,
		BILATERAL as string,
		TRADE_COUNTERPARTYTYPE as string,
		INTERNAL as string,
		cleared_date_CLY as string,
		Modified_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Cleared_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RP as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Orig_CPTY = oSWORIGINALCPTY,
		Product_Description = oPROD_DESC,
		executionTime_Cly = oEXECUTIONDATETIME,
		PM_Response = oOP_RESPONSE,
		CLEARING_CPTY = oCLEARING_CPTY,
		Execution_Time = oEXEC_TIME,
		Trade_Id = oTRADE_ID,
		product_Family = oPRODUCT_FAMILY,
		BILATERAL = oBILATERAL,
		TRADE_COUNTERPARTYTYPE = oTRADE_COUNTERPARTYTYPE,
		INTERNAL = oINTERNAL,
		cleared_date_CLY = oCCPCLEAREDDATE,
		Modified_Date,
		Cleared_Date = oTRADE_CLEARED_DATE,
		RP = oREPORTING_PARTY),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
